name: The 2-1 drill
purpose: Backhand, forehand from the middle, forehand from the wide corner: a classic pattern for moving and turning.

variants.instructions: Your partner blocks to your backhand, then your middle, then your wide forehand. You: backhand, forehand, forehand. Repeat.
Backhand corner, middle, wide forehand. Backhand, then two forehands.
variants.feederInstructions: Backhand, middle, forehand. Steady pace; faster when they're comfortable.

variants.instructions: Robot in a 3-point pattern if it can: backhand, middle, forehand.

coachingPoints: Turn the hips for each forehand
Back to the middle every cycle

name: Pivot and forehand
purpose: Step around the backhand corner and play a forehand from there.

variants.instructions: One ball to your middle (forehand), one to your backhand corner (pivot, forehand). Repeat.
variants.feederInstructions: Middle, then backhand corner. Give them time to recover.

variants.instructions: Your partner blocks to the middle, then to your backhand corner. Play forehands from both, pivoting for the second.
Robot alternating middle and backhand corner. Forehand from both.
No table: from ready, pivot (step back and around with the right foot, left foot if left-handed) and play a shadow forehand. 10 reps, rest, repeat.

success.description: 8 pivots in a row with balanced finishes.

coachingPoints: First step is back and around

name: Cross-over to the wide forehand
purpose: Reach a wide forehand with a cross-over step when a side step is not enough.

variants.instructions: One ball to your backhand corner, then one very wide to your forehand. Cross-over and play the forehand.
variants.feederInstructions: Backhand corner, then wide forehand (off the side if you can).

variants.instructions: Your partner plays backhand, then very wide forehand. Cross-over for the wide one.
Robot alternating backhand corner and wide forehand.
No table: markers 2 metres apart. From the left marker, cross-over to the right and play a shadow forehand. 8 reps each side.

coachingPoints: Push off the left foot, cross with the right (opposite if left-handed)
Play the shot as the foot lands

name: In and out
purpose: Move in for a short ball and back out for a long one without losing balance.

variants.instructions: A short ball (push it), then a long ball (drive or loop it). Repeat.
variants.feederInstructions: Short backspin, then long topspin. Same side.

variants.instructions: Your partner plays short, then long. Push the short one, attack the long one.
If your robot can vary length: short, then long. Push, then attack.
No table: step in with your right foot (left foot if left-handed), shadow push, push off back, shadow drive. 10 reps, rest, repeat.

coachingPoints: Step in with the playing-side foot
Push off it to get back

name: Middle and elbow
purpose: Balls to your playing elbow and the middle: decide forehand or backhand fast.

variants.instructions: Your partner blocks randomly to your middle and elbow. Move and choose: small step for the forehand, or backhand.
Random balls to your middle and elbow.
variants.feederInstructions: Random between their playing elbow and the middle. No pattern.

variants.instructions: Robot random over the middle third of the table.

coachingPoints: Small step out of the way for the forehand

name: Shadow footwork patterns
purpose: Footwork patterns without a table: side steps, pivots and cross-overs with shadow strokes.

variants.instructions: 30 seconds each, 15 seconds rest: side step forehand-backhand; in-and-out; pivot forehand; cross-over and back. Shadow a stroke at every step.

name: Falkenberg, then random
purpose: The Falkenberg pattern for a few cycles, then one random ball: stay alert.

variants.instructions: Two Falkenberg cycles, then your partner plays the next ball anywhere. Play it out.
Two Falkenberg cycles, then one random ball.
variants.feederInstructions: Backhand, backhand, forehand twice, then any spot.

variants.instructions: Robot in Falkenberg pattern with a random ball if it supports it.

coachingPoints: Low and light on your feet

name: Rebound board footwork
purpose: Move between forehand and backhand against the rebound board.

variants.instructions: Rebound board up. Aim alternately left and right of the board's centre so you must move: forehand, side step, backhand, side step.

success.description: 12 in a row, moving every ball.

coachingPoints: Ball in front of you every time
